Scam Artists!. I rarely leave negative reviews, but my experience with Salvia Psychic Ellipsis deserves a warning to anyone considering working with them or using their services.

I applied to be one of their psychic/tarot readers, and the interaction I had with the person representing the company (Claire Salvia) was shockingly unprofessional. No matter what photo I submitted including a highly professional, AI-generated headshot created specifically with LinkedIn-level requirements I was repeatedly told it “wasn’t professional enough.”

When I asked for clarification and then sent screenshots of their own app, showing that many of their current reader profiles use casual photos, tarot-card images, or even AI cartoons, the person I was speaking with became dismissive and argumentative. Instead of acknowledging the inconsistency, they continued to nitpick my photos in a way that felt more like being toyed with than receiving real feedback.

The final message I received told me that if I “can’t handle it,” I should “work somewhere else” despite the fact that I never worked for them at all. The tone was condescending, rude, and completely unprofessional.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this company to potential readers or clients. If this is how they treat people before they even start, it raises serious concerns about how they operate behind the scenes.

Proceed with caution.
